item.description: Rechtspraak (civiel), 06-11-2026. Graafschade drinkwaterleiding. Boren met handbediende grondboor is mechanisch grondroeren (art. 1 WIBON). Geen graafmelding en geen lokalisatie ingetekende leiding: schending zorgplicht en CROW 500. Causaal verband via omkeringsregel. Geen eigen schuld netbeheerder. Abstract begrote schade onvoldoende betwist, toegewezen.

item.title: EU backs global compact to cut energy bills and emissions from buildings
item.description: Europese Commissie, 20-11-2026. Today, the European Union has endorsed the Antalya Compact for Energy Efficient Buildings, an initiative to reduce buildings’ energy intensity - energy consumed per m² - by at least 25% by 2035.

item.description: Europese Commissie, 19-11-2026. This morning, the European Parliament and Council reached a provisional agreement on the amendment to the EU Methane Regulation to postpone by 2 years the application of certain requirements for natural gas, crude oil and coal importers and EU operators.
